instruction_covers: site_name is the URL hostname stripped of credentials/port ('example.com')
title prefers over first <h1>; description prefers meta description, then <p> after first <h1>, then first <p>

image prefers post-

sibling/later image, else first document , skipping without src; empty/malformed HTML leaves title/description/image None

favicon discovery: the four valid rels with non-empty href, duplicates and document order preserved; sizes None when absent or 'any', else tuple(s) of int pairs accepting '32x32 16x16' and '64×64'; absolute_favicon resolves relative hrefs; invalid/empty rel and empty href ignored
to_dict() includes favicon and absolute_favicon with the same tuple values; link_preview signature with parser defaulting to None

notes: Repeatability / fresh-process / supplied-content tests are guardrails satisfied by any sane pure implementation that parses the given content (parser=None is the documented default); they require no extra feature beyond the stated fallback contract.
